compilation_policies.case_object_contract: Exactly one reaction_or_source_gap, one source_annotation, and one mechanism_hypothesis record per follow-on case.
compilation_policies.reaction_gap_policy: A zero-row official Rhea EC query remains a documented source gap; M-CSA participant context may be attached only with explicit non-Rhea source scope.
compilation_policies.source_step_policy: Detailed, non-product M-CSA steps are retained in source order with exact descriptions and source-ordered Marvin MEFlow endpoints; no atom mapping is inferred.
compilation_policies.terminal_state_policy: M-CSA product-state rows are retained as terminal source step identifiers but are not counted as elementary mechanism steps.
compilation_policies.non_detailed_policy: A high-rated is_detailed=false M-CSA mechanism produces zero discrete steps and a mandatory machine-visible detail abstention.
compilation_policies.site_mapping_policy: M-CSA reference residue mappings must match UniProt natural-sequence identity and local mmCIF coordinates; direct target structures are mapped independently through UniProt chain ranges.
compilation_policies.structure_policy: Static, condition-specific, inhibitor-bound, engineered, or complex-specific structures retain explicit applicability and cannot be treated as turnover trajectories.
compilation_policies.hypothesis_policy: Tier 2 integrates source reaction, proposal, site, structure, uncertainty, and relationship fields without upgrading source curation to independent validation.
compilation_policies.registry_policy: No protected registry or historical fingerprint is mutated during compilation.

supports: A ten-case query surface consisting of the unchanged Atlas-3 kernel plus seven source-bound follow-on evidence packages.
Machine-queryable reaction gaps, source granularity, M-CSA curved-arrow endpoints, residue-number mappings, structure applicability, uncertainty, and two bounded relationship projections.
does_not_support: Ten equally detailed mechanisms, representative benchmark coverage, independent biological validation, prospective discovery, atom-mapped bond edits, complete turnover trajectories, or design readiness.
